name: The Game of Fourtune
source:
[i]Clyde Raveron & Devon Rhodes find themselves trapped in a sadistic game of life and death, where they and fourteen other people must fight, scheme, and outsmart one another to survive a god's deadly game.  Can they survive the ordeal?  Or will they find themselves lost in the oblivion of this vile game?[/i]

The Game of Fourtune is a death game visual novel that focuses on a cast of 16 characters trying to fight, scheme, and survive a variety of deadly games in order to have a wish granted.  There are multiple routes and decisions that will show different characters, games, and reveal various parts of the game's greater plot.   Traverse through multiple different but deadly games and puzzles to determine the fate of these 16 troubled souls.
translation:
[i]克莱德·雷弗伦与德文·罗兹发现自己被困在一场残酷的生死游戏中。他们必须与另外十四人相互争斗、算计，靠智慧胜过对方，才能在神明的致命游戏里活下来。他们能熬过这场磨难吗？还是会被这场恶毒的游戏吞没，彻底消失？[/i]

《The Game of Fourtune》是一部死亡游戏题材的视觉小说。十六名角色为了实现愿望，在各式致命游戏中搏斗、谋划，拼命求生。多条路线与不同选择将带你了解不同的角色与游戏，逐步揭开整体剧情的各个部分。穿越一场场各不相同的致命游戏，解开谜题，决定这十六个饱受困扰的灵魂的命运。
